features: New tool — TimeTracker: 40h/week working-hours tracker with single-file PHP + SQLite backend, session start/stop with notes, vacations, monthly adjustments, holidays, and configurable per-weekday hours plus intensive-period presets (e.g. summer schedule).

PoVRadar: brand new Metrics Dashboard is now the default landing view — global filters by date range (Current/Last FY, YTD, current/last quarter, last 90/365 days, all time, custom), product and owner.
PoVRadar: engagement mix cards (Opportunities / Post Sales / Events), KPI tiles with previous-period deltas, and one-click CSV export of the filtered dataset.
PoVRadar: new charts — Commercial Outcomes and Technical Outcomes donuts, Tech × Commercial matrix, Won amount by month, Win rate by product, and Loss Reasons distribution.
PoVRadar: District Breakdown — stacked charts of TRR count and amount per district (Active / Won / Lost / No Decision), plus footer note listing TRRs with no district assigned.
PoVRadar: Support Activities section — dedicated KPIs and Top-10 accounts (by count and by amount) for Post Sales and Events, split between activity on Opp accounts vs. standalone.
PoVRadar: new sidebar widgets — TRRs by District and This FY card with Won/Closed counters, Win Rate bar and Won amount.
PoVRadar: new Quick View filter Outcome Pending with badge counter for closed TRRs still missing commercial outcome.

PoVRadar: TRR form extended with Technical Outcome (Technical Win / Partial / Technical Loss), District (with autocomplete from existing districts) and a Close Details block that appears when Status = Closed, requiring Actual Close Date, Commercial Outcome, Final Amount (Won) and Loss Reason (Lost).
PoVRadar: new Fiscal Year Settings entry in the tools menu to configure the FY used across dashboards and widgets.
New access system with Partner Edition (password) and SE Edition (GitHub PAT or base64 token).
Dynamic tools hub: deploy tools from private GitHub repos via base64 access tokens with one-click install.
New Admin Panel: token generator with configurable expiry date, bulk tool loader, and active tools management with delete.
Tool cards now display the creator name and expiry status badges.
Cortex Audit: updated compatibility to XDR 5.1 & XSIAM 3.5.
Cortex Audit: NGFW Log Ingestion check rewritten with new XQL query that now also reports Threat, URL, File, and GlobalProtect log delivery.
Cortex Audit: Linux policy matrix corrected — Local File Threat Examination (LTEE) replaces ELF Loading Examination to match the current Cortex XDR UI.
Cortex Audit: XQL error responses now include the HTTP status code for faster diagnosis.
Added the ability to download in PDF format, as well as adding the type of report to download to the file name.
Fix in the API query for unknown datasets.
Bug in PoVRadar. Removed closed state in the forecast.
Bug in ContentImporter. Now we're able to upload Dashboards correctly.
Added OTA Update System with direct GitHub Tarball download.
Fixed Setup Wizard skip button logic.
Redesigned sidebar for all Cortex tools to a compact 260px width.
Introduced GitHub PAT integration for Content Importer.
Added smart logic to handle missing .git folders in Docker.
